why: Each day you remove floor(w/2) from one chocolate, and the heaviest chocolate always gives the biggest removal, so the greedy is 'halve the current maximum' d times. A max-heap gives the current maximum each day.
hints: Which chocolate should you eat from today to remove the most weight? Does today's choice ever hurt later days?
Eating from the heaviest chocolate removes the most today, and halving a lighter one never helps more later (halves of bigger values stay at least as big). So always halve the current maximum.
Max-heap (negate values in Python): each day pop the top w, subtract w//2 from the total, push back w - w//2. Stop early when the top is 1 (nothing more can be eaten). O((n + d) log n).
pitfalls: The eaten part is floor(w/2), so the remaining part is w - w//2 (ceil), not w//2.
d can be up to 2*10^6, far more than needed; once the heaviest chocolate weighs 1, stop.
The same chocolate can be picked again on later days, so push it back after halving.
